blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House Committee on Energy approved on Monday substitute bills, along with their corresponding committee reports, which will remove the system loss charge from electric bills and liberalize power generation down to the consumer level. Since President Ferdinand Marcos identified the system loss issue in his last State of the Nation Address (SONA), 43 bills and two resolutions have been filed in the House of Representatives proposing to end the practice of passing on to consumers the costs of inefficiencies arising from non-technical energy losses.
